texts: On day 230 of Year 1, Coraline Ash began a solo stretch of thirty nights at the Harbor Station.
Pell did not accompany Coraline Ash during the solo stretch.
Pell visited the Harbor Station on her own off-nights.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash tended the lantern of the Harbor Station every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash lit the lantern at sundown every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash refreshed the mire-essence at midnight every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash trimmed the wick at the third watch every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash extinguished the lantern at dawn every night.
Coraline Ash kept the notebook carefully.

q1_issues.issue: "on her own off-nights" is flattened to the bare kind symbol off_night, silently dropping the possessive restriction ("her own") and the plurality, which widens the claim from Pell's own off-nights to off-nights in general.

(Inheritance off_night off) exposes a modifier genus that fails the predication test ("the night is off") and is not a gradable, positional/cardinal or material adjective, so "off" should have stayed inside the compound symbol.

the compound symbol third_watch is minted with no decomposition atoms, while off_night and mire_essence in the same parse do get theirs, so the mandatory head genus (Inheritance third_watch watch) is missing.

q2_gaps: a possessed / plural temporal NP as a time adjunct ("on her own off-nights"): the Time machinery covers calendar terms, deictic constants and bare day-part symbols, with no form that carries a possessor or the recurrence the plural implies

an inceptive verb whose complement is an event-noun NP rather than a to-V / V-ing clause ("began a solo stretch of thirty nights"): the Inception section fixes the Ongoing+Past marking only for a verbal complement, leaving the begun nominal's status undetermined
a named watch/period NP as a Time filler ("at the third watch"): neither a calendar term, a deictic, nor a listed day-part constant
review.notes: The nightly clauses correctly take the flat habitual form (Time slot + Every 1 day) and the parse correctly withholds the wick-lantern PartOf that Core patterns explicitly bars. The one substantive loss is the dropped possessive on "her own off-nights".

issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction -- 'an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion' -- yet the possessed plural 'her own off-nights' is flattened to the unrestricted bare constant in (Time sk_visit_1 off_night), widening the claim from Pell's own off-nights to off-nights at large.

Compound concepts exposes a modifier genus only when the modifier is an adjectival property predicable of the referent (gradable, positional/cardinal, or material), and 'off' fails that test (*'the night is off'), so (Inheritance off_night off) is an unlicensed atom.

'the third watch' is a named time-slot constant, not the predicate/class/property/action symbol Compound concepts governs -- the Time section keeps day-part and named-period times as bare symbols (the instructions' this_morning / last_week / first_quarter, and sundown, midnight and dawn in this very parse), none of which carry a genus, so no decomposition was owed.

gaps_confirmed: A possessed / plural temporal NP as a time adjunct ('on her own off-nights'): the Time filler vocabulary (structured calendar terms, deictic constants, day-part symbols) has no form that carries a possessor or the recurrence the plural implies.

An inceptive whose complement is a nominal eventuality ('began a solo stretch of thirty nights'): Inception fixes the Theme + Ongoing marking only for a verbal complement, leaving the begun nominal's aspect undetermined.
new_gaps: A past-bounded habitual ('During the solo stretch, ... every night'): Frequency & habitual schedules requires the recurring event to stay status-unmarked, but the clause is past tense and bounded by a stated interval -- nothing states how Past and a bounding During combine with Every, so the bounding of a recurrence has no licensed carrier.
A day-of-year date ('on day 230 of Year 1'): (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot of the calendar-term vocabulary, and no term names an ordinal day within a year.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form carries the possessor -- the possessed plural as a group witness, (GroupOf sk_offnight_1 off_night) (Possession sk_offnight_1 pell), filling the Time slot -- and if no entity may fill Time then the adjunct must be dropped with the gap recorded, never emitted unrestricted. Issue 1: the compliant form keeps only the head genus (Inheritance off_night night) and omits (Inheritance off_night off).
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's third gap (a named watch period as a Time filler) is not a gap: 'a deictic or named time stays a bare symbol' covers it, as the instructions' own first_quarter constant shows. Otherwise the parse is sound -- the nightly clauses take the flat habitual Time + Every form, and the wick-lantern PartOf that Core patterns explicitly bars is correctly withheld.
